hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1

tool_input.command: hops fg create customers5077c5 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string:unique record key,name:string,balance_eur:double:balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:epoch ms event time" --description "Customers initial schema" 2>&1
